ResearcherNotesProject: Discovered 2026-06 discovery sweep. Capacity not yet published for the Mozambique units (a 2 mtpa / 135,000-174,000 cbm FSU figure in press refers to the related South Africa terminal); left blank pending a primary source. Owner: Empresa Nacional de Hidrocarbonetos EP; Caminhos de Ferro de Moçambique; Electricidade de Moçambique; Hidroeléctrica de Cahora Bassa
Source: Mozambique Council of Ministers 39th Ordinary Session decree (Nov 2025) granting a 30-year concession for reception, storage, regasification and transport of natural gas; the decree names the Port of Beira and Inhassoro, with an FSRU anchored at Inhambane/Inhassoro. INP regulator approved the concession decree. Sponsor is a state-owned special-purpose entity (ENH, CFM, EDM, HCB) plus technical/financial partners to be selected.
ResearcherNotesProject: Discovered 2026-06 discovery sweep. Second of two FSRU import terminals under the same 30-year concession (see Beira FSRU). INP decree text names 'Port of Beira and Inhassoro'; trade press (LNG Prime, intellinews, offshore-technology) describes the second FSRU as anchored at Inhambane — Inhassoro is a coastal district within Inhambane Province, so these refer to the same southern site. Sponsor: state SPV ENH/CFM/EDM/HCB plus unselected technical/financial partners. Gas for domestic market / gas-to-power; feeds ROMPCO pipeline. Capacity and FSRU vessel not yet published; lat/long approximate (Inhassoro). If a future source shows the southern FSRU is at a different point than Inhassoro, reconcile name/location accordingly.
